author: Tyler Bailey
title: Your first for Thursday, December 13
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of Morgan Stanley .
Tim Seymour was a buyer of American Airlines .
Brian Kelly was a buyer of the Gold Shares ETF .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Nordstrom .
